verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe presenter-led avatar video made without filming. Stock options include 1,100+ AI actors. Custom options include a digital twin from a 15-second video or a Photo Avatar from a single still image, with lip-sync to your script. Text-driven generation offers control over avatar and voice, and lines can be updated without returning to the studio. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the script-to-avatar workflow (community evidence covers only dubbing/translation).
